capabilities: Render Stadia Maps vector tiles and styles
disambiguation: Not a standalone places manager; it is a map provider that requires the Places plugin.
extras: Not standalone; requires the Places plugin. README points to a sandbox for examples.
intentEvidence: This is not a stand-alone plugin, to use, install along side Places.
problem: Places needs a map provider to render maps and handle geospatial requests; this plugin supplies Stadia Maps for that role.

relations.evidence: This is not a stand-alone plugin, to use, install along side Places.

summary: Map provider for Places that adds Stadia Maps vector tiles, POI search, directions, isochrones, elevation, track snapping and matching, and 3D terrain.
